content_blocks.label: clause_1._Premises
content_blocks.text: Landlord hereby leases to Tenant the premises located at 123 Maple Street, Springfield City.

content_blocks.label: clause_2._Term
content_blocks.text: The term of this lease shall commence on November 1, 2024, and shall continue until October 31, 2025, unless terminated earlier by either party.

content_blocks.label: clause_3._Rental_Payment
content_blocks.text: Tenant shall pay rent in the amount of $1,200 per month, due on the first day of each month.
